title: Daily nearness-to-26-week-high momentum gate with hysteresis exit

source.title: Impact of size and volume on cryptocurrency momentum and reversal (FFA Working Papers)

rule_summary: Daily signals from closed daily candles, executed at the next 1h open. Define H(d) = highest daily high of the 182 days ending at day d (including d). Nearness N(d) = close(d)/H(d). ENTRY when a daily candle closes with N(d) >= 0.95 and no position is open. EXIT when a daily candle closes with N(d) < 0.85. Between 0.85 and 0.95 hold the current state (hysteresis). No other filters, no take-profit, no leverage, one position per pair. Parameters: window 182 days, entry 0.95, exit 0.85.
mechanism: Investors anchor on recent highs and are reluctant to bid prices up to and through them, so good news is underreacted to near the high (George-Hwang anchoring). Sellers who sell near the high give away the slow drift. The paper gives distance from the k-week high as a predictor for large liquid coins, which BTC, ETH and BNB are; the exact trading rule here is my own adaptation.
